messages:
anya: Heads up - I'm seeing a burst of rejoin events from EU edge after the router canary. Billing shows duplicated token counts for a handful of mobile SSE sessions.

michael: Posted a console snapshot: https://redwood.console/snap/2026-03-21-23-51 (redacted)

sam: what's the repro? SSE or WS? SDK version? network pattern?

anya: SSE from iOS SDK v1.4.2. Steps: flaky cellular -> client reconnects -> server logs show two routes accepting same session_id and we get charged on both for ~20-40s.

lei: paste the headers you're seeing so I can check resume-token usage.

anya: observed request headers - GET /stream?session_id=abc123 HTTP/1.1; Host: stream.eu.redwood.ai; Accept: text/event-stream; User-Agent: MySDK/1.4.2; X-Resume-Token: null

michael: deploy-bot: canary pushed at 23:48 UTC - feature flag "session-resync-v2" enabled for EU edges (~42%).

deploy-bot: (automated) canary rollout 42% EU edges - flag=session-resync-v2

sam: quick hypothesis: resync-v2 does optimistic rejoin (bind to new route) and racing fallback leaves old route active until lease TTL; both routes accept and get charged.

lei: telemetry backfill shows two distinct route_ids for the same session_id during that window. Query: select route_id from streaming_events where session_id='abc123' and ts between ... => route A then route B within 400ms.

michael: do we see duplicate token emission or just duplicate accounting? need trace ids to confirm double-serving.

anya: traces attached: trace_id=tr-9876. Logs: [23:49:01.123] route=A accept session_id=abc123 lease=30s trace=tr-9876; [23:49:01.548] route=B accept session_id=abc123 lease=30s trace=tr-9876; [23:49:20.000] route=A lease-expire session_id=abc123

sam: that's a race. two routes bind same trace. Mitigation: rollback resync-v2 in EU. Long term: make resync idempotent (claim lease before charging) or ensure resume-token strongly binds to single route.

lei: console UX problem: streaming dashboard aggregates by route only, no session_id column, so ops can't pivot from billing spike -> affected sessions. Proposal: add session_id column + new "duplicate-session" alert when same session_id appears on >1 active route within 60s.

michael: agree. also server-side heuristic: if same session_id & same trace_id appear on multiple routes within X ms, treat second accept as resume (no bill) until lease confirmed. reduces blast radius of optimistic rejoin.

sam: be careful with heuristics (client could spoof session_id). Better: require lease-claim handshake before billing. If claim fails, don't charge.

anya: starting rollback now - ping when rollback completes. :pray: 

deploy-bot: (automated) rollback started for flag=session-resync-v2 in region=eu-west-1

sam: I'll open infra PR for "lease-before-charge" pattern and a console patch to surface session_id in top-level streaming dashboard. Drafting RFC.

lei: add unit test in SDK to ensure resume-token preserved across network flaps; found a case where token got cleared on iOS reconnect.

anya: filed SRE ticket SRE-1356 to track rollback + followups. Thanks team.
